title: 4521-INF-LOI-039-062-0001-GAR Rev00 Monthly Progress Report - Jan 18
summary:
- Monthly Progress Report for Arizona Solar One project HEX replacement TES Solana.
- Report covers activities from Lointek until May 7th, 2018.
- Manufacturing progress of Oil-to-Salt Heat Exchangers is at 91%.
- Pending issues include confirming civil works and hydrotest schedule.
- Invoices for various project milestones have been paid.
- Monthly progress report for January 2018.
- Document includes various documents related to manufacturing planning, document lists, and inspection procedures.
- Purchase plan and material procurement details are provided for Solana Generating Station.
- Key suppliers include ForgiatURA Morandini, TUBOS REUNIDOS, HIERROS MARCELINO FRANCO, and INDUSTEEL BELGIUM.
